locations.description:
**NOTICE:** This Item is _missable_ as you cannot return to it after the Chapter 4 boss.

Grants Auto-Life at the start of battle. Breaks upon use.

_Earrings imbued with a spirit capable of restoring one's fading consciousness._

locations.title: Speed Demon Keychain
locations.description:
Awarded for making it to Roche with all five 7th Infantry Troopers alive. Slightly replenishes ATB gauge when using a weapon ability.

_An official keychain produced by passionate fans of the motorcycle madman Roche._

locations.title: Assess Materia Earrings
locations.description:
Win the surprise exhibition match at the end of the Queen's Blood tournament. Allows use of the highest level of Assess materia, granting the ability to scan all enemies in the field.

Winning will also get you two Queen's Blood cards for free:
- Card #065: Ifrit
- Card #115: Terror of the Deep

_Earrings which incorporate an orb of Assess materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic.

locations.title: Circlet

Increases max MP by 10%, and magic power by 5%.

locations.description:

_An elaborate neckpiece that imparts peace of mind to the wearer._

_Earrings imbued with a spirit capable of restoring one's fading consciousness._

locations.description:

_A magic ring that ensnares the heart and mind of any who look upon it._

locations.description:

Slightly fills the ATB gauge at the start of battle.

**Defense:** 11

**Magic Defense:** 43

****WARNING:**** All collectibles after the Cooling Chamber are ***MISSABLE***, including this materia! It will be impossible to get it after you've entered the Reactor Core!

**Type:** Magic (Green)

At the very end of the hallway where the [Rest Spot](#loc=330161) is. Check the southwestern end to find it at the dead-end, past the nearby.

_Allows you to use subversive spells._

locations.title: Lv. 1 Warding Materia
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit the Gongaga Reactor

**Type:** Command Materia (Blue)

Reach this ledge by bouncing off the [Big Mushroom](#loc=330550) to the north using a Chocobo.

_Grants resistance to the linked Materia's detrimental status effect._

locations.title: Lv. 3 Prayer Materia
locations.description:
**Type:** Command (Yellow)

Complete [Training Facility B-T](#loc=330817) to unlock this chest.

_Allows you to restore the party's HP with Pray._

locations.title: Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia
locations.description:
**Type:** Support Materia (Blue)

Can be found inside the crater.

_Increases the level of the linked Materia by one. Has no effect when paired with Materia at maximum level._

locations.title: Lv. 3 Healing Materia
locations.description:
**Type:** Green (Magic)

On the ledge up the climbable wall.

_??_

locations.title: Lv. 2 Fortification Materia
locations.description: From the Phoenix Down, head down the stairs and then clamber down the green wall to find this Materia at the bottom.

locations.title: Lv. 2 Empowerment Materia
locations.description:
**Type:** Green (Magic)

After passing through the second gate, head forward up the stairs and then climb up the right-hand wall. At the very top, defeat the four Two-Faces, then grab this Materia in the eastern corner of the battlefield.

_??_

locations.title: Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia
locations.description: On the upper floor of the barn, between the fireplace and the bed.

media.title: Nibel Region - Chocobo Sage's Manor - Materia 1

locations.title: Lv. 1 HP<=>MP Materia
locations.description:
**NOTICE:** This Materia only appears during Chapter 11. It is not available during Chapter 1.

**Type:** Complete Materia (Purple

In front and to the left of the Mako spring in the cave, with the cutscene.

_Swaps your HP and MP values._

locations.title: Lv. 1 Warding Materia
locations.description: After climbing up the cliff, head forward southeast and up the hill to find this Materia at the top.

locations.title: Lv. 1 Barrier Materia
locations.description: After the hallway filled with wooden boxes, defeat the Black Bat and Rictus, then head to the southeastern side of the room to find this Materia near a small rusty fence and a box dispenser.

locations.title: Lv. 1 ATK<=>MATK Materia
locations.description: At the very top of Ventilation Control, on 4F. To get here, roll up only using the blue ventilation ducts, without changing the power generator on the ground floor.

locations.title: Lv. 5 Chakra Materia
locations.description: After using the Rubystar Gear crystal to rotate your gravity for the first time,  head down the stairs and fight the two Ancient Dragons. Go through the archway, then turn left and climb up the rubble to get onto the balcony. The Materia will be there.

locations.title: Lv. 1 EXP Up Materia
locations.description:
**Type:** Complete (Purple)

After jumping down the waterfall, head up the staircases and use the yellow Amberstar Chamber on the right to turn gravity. Head all the way to the top of the stairs to find the Materia.

_Increases the amount of EXP you earn in battle._

locations.title: Lv. 3 Steadfast Block Materia
locations.description: At the third altar, Order's Altar, restore the southern Vessel of Life to restore an area called Safe Haven. Head down the corridor and take the second door on the left to find this Materia in the arena, guarded by two Cthonilizards and a Kelzmelzer.

locations.title: Lv. 2 Subversion Materia
locations.description: In the second Aerith and Yuffie section, in the tower to the east of altar, Salvation's Altar. Find it in the empty doorway leading nowhere.

locations.title: Moogle Medal
locations.description: Climb up the ladder to the left of [Chloe's Tack Shop](#loc=324188), then back south to the end of the walkway.

locations.title: 5x Moogle Medals
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the "A Planetological Review" story objective.

In the Cosmo Canyon Observatory's treasury, on the upper-most floor.

locations.title: 3x Moogle Medals
locations.description: Part of the [Rustladen Reservoir cache site](#loc=323827).

locations.title: Sleek Saber
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cloud

Inside a chest at the Abandoned Docks. 

_A republic-era blade polished into a refined shape and sheen._

**Ability:** Firebolt Blade — Imbue your sword with fire and lightning while slicing a foe. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Exploit an enemy's weakness.

locations.title: Timeless Rod
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

Inside a chest, to the right of Chloe's Tack Shop.

_A charming staff carved from a millennia-old tree._

**Ability:** Chrono Aegis — Raise a barrier that damages and temporarily freezes enemies who attempt to strike you.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy and inflict Stop.

locations.title: Hi-Caliber Rifle
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

Purple chest on the shore within the swamp.

_A retro firearm repurposed from a republic-era weapon._

**Ability:** Bonus Round — Load your weapon with unique bullets that increase stagger and power up your attacks.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Fire 20 bullets.

locations.title: Sylph Gloves
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Tifa

Next to the top of the ladder leading down to the floor below.

_Gloves that slice through the air to deliver sharp strikes._

**Ability:** Reverse Gale — Knock enemies into the air or bring them crashing down with a wind-aspected attack. Launches enemies toward you. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Exploit an enemy's weakness to Wind.

locations.title: Renegade's Collar
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

To the left of the Rest Spot.

_A collar made during the war as a symbol of revolt._

**Ability:** Crescent Claw — Slash at a foe. Deplete the gauge while in Vengeance Mode to increase potency and range.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy.

locations.title: Empress's Scepter
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

In the back corner of Aerith's room, once the group has booked a night at the Inn. If you already have the Empress's Scepter, this will have 2,500 gil in it instead.

_A historied staff once offered as a gift to Her Majesty._

**Ability:** Radiant Ward — Conjur a ward that grants invincibility while casting spells. Strengthens Aerith's basic attack.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy with a standard attack launched from within the ward.

locations.title: Rune Blade
locations.description:
**NOTICE:** This weapon is _MISSABLE_. If you don't pick it up for free here, you'll have to spend money for it at a Weapons Shop!

**Party Member:** Cloud

To the right of the Rest Spot after the parade. Can only be collected during the events of Chapter 4. This weapon is _MISSABLE_ as you cannot return to it after encountering the Chapter 4 boss. If you do, you'll have to buy it later from a Weapons Vendor.

_A greatsword inscribed with characters from a mystical, ancient script._

**Ability:** Disorder — Deliver a devastating attack while switching modes. Fills the ATB gauge when the attack connects. Can be used while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike with Attack or Strong Attack after switching modes.

locations.title: Wizard's Rod
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

Facing the Rest Spot, head around the left-hand corner to find the chest.

_A magical staff once wielded by a formidable spellcaster_

**Ability:** Lustrous Shield — Conjure a magical shield that keeps enemies at bay and stops projectiles.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Defend against an enemy's attack (one time only while active).

locations.title: Twin Viper
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Yuffie

Next to the switch you have to pull to get the ascending ropes working.

_A throwing star that fuses two crescent-shaped sickles into one deadly weapon._

**Ability:** Windstorm — Create a gust of wind that damages nearby enemies and launches them toward you.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike two or more enemies.

locations.title: Barrage Blaster
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

On the lower-most floor of the Railway Control Tower with the yellow ascension ropes.

_A heavy-artillery firearm equipped with multiple barrels for maximum lethality._

**Ability:** Lifesaver — Temporarily increase your HP and take damage intended for other party members.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Use your HP to heal allies (one time only while active).

locations.title: Amethyst Collar
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

**Requires:** Start [Of Robed Men and Ransoms](#loc=325424)

In the northwestern dead-end in the first room of the [Old South Corel Mine](#loc=323797).

_An elegant collar embedded with mystical purple gemstones._

**Ability:** Supernal Fervor — Grant Haste on all party members. Can only be used during Vengeance Mode. Costs 2 ATB.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate on a three-person party.

locations.title: Umbral Blade
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cloud

Next to the entrance into Dio's Solemnitude Manor.

_A mystifying sword forged from a gem that emits an eerie glow._

**Ability:** Prime Mode — Strengthen Punisher Mode. Hold down Attack to deliver three consecutive strikes. Increases Berserk potency.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy while active.

locations.title: Vulcan Cannon
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

At the end of the ramp leading down to the [Scrapyard Prison Cell](#loc=325427).

_A gunarm that fires faster as its three barrels begin to rotate._

**Ability:** Charging Uppercut — Rush toward an enemy and launch them into the air with a furious blow. Increases Charge.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Top up the Overcharge gauge.

locations.title: Crystal Megaphone
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cait Sith

**Prerequisite:** Complete the "A Planetological Review" story objective.

In the Cosmo Canyon Observatory's treasury, on the lower-most floor.

_A megaphone whose gorgeous gems add a soothing resonance to the user's voice._

**Ability:** Moogle Magic — Use an equipped Summon's Ability. Can only use while riding the Moogle during battles in which Summons are available. Cooldown increases with each use.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy.

locations.title: Kaiser Knuckles
locations.description:
**NOTICE:** This weapon is _MISSABLE_. If you don't pick it up for free here, you'll have to spend money for it at a Weapons Shop!

**Party Member:** Tifa

In a purple chest up the southeastern steps from the arena where you fight your first Daemonic Entity (the green on-foot humanoid monster). This is the first fight you'll have in the cargo hold of the ship.

_Gloves fitted with sharp metal spikes to pack an extra punch._

**Ability:** Overpower — Use with other attacks to more effectively pressure enemies. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Follow up with Attack after using the weapon ability.

locations.title: Silver Collar
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

Awarded for winning first place with no tie in [Run Wild's](#loc=323965) Free-for-All challenge.

_A collar wrought from a high-quality metal said to ward off magical fiends._

**Ability:** Chilling Roar — Retaliate with ice shards whenever hit by an attack. Charges the Vengeance Gauge when a counterstrike lands.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Exploit an enemy's weakness.

locations.title: Bird of Prey
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Yuffie

In a chest at the back of the house with the Rest Stop in it.

_A tricky throwing star wielded by seasoned hunters of the forest._

**Ability:** Doppelganger — Conjure a clone of yourself that temporarily mimics your actions. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy while the clone is present.

locations.title: Red Megaphone
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cait Sith

In the shaded cave accessible via the river.

_A megaphone that helps its user pour their heart into their cheering._

**Ability:** Moogle Kaboom — Turn your moogle into a ticking time bomb that explodes when it leaves combat.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy.

locations.title: Crystal Sword
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cloud

At the room with the first enemies in the reactor, vault southeast through the doorway and check the back-right corner of the new room.

_A finely honed greatsword hewn from an enormous gemstone._

**Ability:** Infinity's End — Wind up and unleash an overhead strike. Increased damage on Stagger. Costs 2 ATB.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike a staggered enemy.

locations.title: Golden Collar
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

At a certain point you'll have to pull a cart on tracks to give enough length for a power cable. Pull this cart as far as you can, then use it to get up to a vent shaft. On the other side, drop down, then climb right to find the chest on top of a shipping container.

_An opulent collar forged from gold found in a forest stream._

**Ability:** Watcher's Respite — Deplete the Vengeance Gauge to heal allies. Potency proportional to amount expended.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate when the Vengeance Gauge is full.

locations.title: Tiger Fangs
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Tifa

****WARNING:**** All of the chests obtained in Tifa's reactor run are ***MISSABLE***, including this one! It will be impossible to open this chest after you've entered the Reactor Core!

In the long flooded corridor with the red walkways, grapple up through the ceiling, then face northeast. On an upper ledge will be this chest: use the grapple points on your left to get up to it.

_Savage gloves inspired by the sharp teeth of a beast of prey._

**Ability:** Chi Trap — Create an orb of materialized chi that deals damage on contact.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy.

locations.title: Resounding Megaphone
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cait Sith

Among the bushes west of the Telephone Booth.

_A megaphone that allows the user's voice to echo out across hill and vale._

**Ability:** Moogle Mine — Use the moogle to scatter landmines that explode upon enemy contact. Moderately increases stagger.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Stagger an enemy with a mine explosion.

locations.title: Mystic Collar
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

***WARNING:*** This Weapon is _missable!_ If you do not get it before returning the Ruby Gi Statue to Bugenhagen, it will be inaccessible until you unlock Chapter Select!

Up on the ledge to the right of the exit door.

_A dignified collar once worn by Watchers of the Vale_

**Ability:** Watcher's Spirit — Deplete the Vengeance Gauge to increase allies' ATB. Potency proportional to the amount expended.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate when the Vengence Gauge is full.

media.title: Cave of the Gi - Mystic Collar

locations.title: Calamitous Bazooka
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

At the first gate, in the lower area just across from it, guarded by a Stinger and a pair of Two-Faces.

_A wicked firearm imbued with the rancor of a tribe of fallen warriors._

**Ability:** Smackdown — Strike the ground and send nearby enemies flying.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike two or more enemies.

locations.title: Ceremonial Staff
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

To the left of the Rest Spot in the Village of the Gi, near the shoreline.

_A sacred staff used as part of a ritual prayer to the planet._

**Ability:** ATB Ward — Conjure a ward. Fill ATB changes within the ward to increase your allies' ATB gauges.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate the effects of the ward (one time only while ward is on the field).

locations.title: Crystal Gloves
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Tifa

Next to the fence of the Shinra facility across the bridge, in front of a wooden shelter inside some scaffolding.

_Gloves studded with gemstones that house magic power._

**Ability:** Unfettered Fury — Imbue your unbridled attacks with non-elemental magic. Increases stagger.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Stagger an enemy with a standard attack while Unfettered Fury is active.

locations.title: Igneous Saber
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cloud

On top of the structure between the two climbable walls.

_A curved greatsword forged from hardened volcanic magma._

**Ability:** Blade Burst — Unleash a wave of non-elemental mako energy at an enemy in front of you with a slash of your sword.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy.

locations.title: Golden Megaphone
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cait Sith

After rolling through the first duct and defeating the Bahba Velamyu, call the Moogle stand on the button on the west side of the room to drop a crate in. Pick it up and then toss it onto the button partway up the southeastern wall. This will open up a door with this chest behind it!

_A glimmering megaphone used by some to scare off the most ferocious of beasts._

**Ability:** Moogle Knuckle — Use the moogle to deliver a fistful of pain. Increased stagger damage bonus.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike a staggered enemy.

locations.title: Plumose Rod
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

In Hojo's secret laboratory. Unlock it by completing all Evaluation challenges in the [Mako Research Combat Simulator](#loc=348951).

_A bewitching staff decorated with the feathers of a bird known for its beautiful song._

**Ability:** Ray of Judgement — Fire an energy burst that hits multiple times. Increased stagger damage bonus.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike a staggered enemy.

locations.title: Crystalline Cross
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Yuffie

Found in the northeastern room of the backstage Utilidor area on 1F. You're able to explore this area during Chapter 12's story.

_A throwing star fitted with four sharp, gem-hewn blades._

**Ability:** Banishment — ATB spent on other commands increases damage dealt. Affinity changed with Ninjutsu. Can use while airborne. Shares gauge with Purification. Max Level : III.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy with a Level III attack.

locations.title: Slipstream Saber
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cloud

After using the Rubystar to turn gravity, go down the stairs and to the vines. Climb directly up to reach a balcony with this chest on it to the right. If you already have this, you'll find 6,500 gil instead.

_A greatsword whose power has been greatly enhanced by the mako coursing through its blade._

**Ability:** Counterstance — Brace for attacks and retaliate. Activate at the right time to reduce damage. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Unleash a counterattack.

locations.title: Járngreipr
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Tifa

After first descending into the blustery Lifestream area, you'll fight some Riot Troopers and a Type G Slug-Ray. Defeat them, then vault into the next area: the Járngreipr gloves are on the left-hand side. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead.

_Gloves embedded with strength-enhancing energy cores._

**Ability:** True Strike — Deliver a tremendous blow at close range. Increased stagger damage bonus.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike a staggered enemy.

locations.title: Gambanteinn
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Aerith

At the second altar, Mercy's Altar, restore the western Vessel of Life to restore a tower, called Wall of Denial. Descend to the bottom, then check under the stairs to find this chest. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead.

_A superior staff made by the Cetra to help them protect the planet._

**Ability:** Noble Sacrifice — Sacrifice yourself to revive fallen allies, restore their HP, and remove detrimental status effects. Costs. 2 ATB.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate when an ally is in critical condition or unconscious.

locations.title: Battle Cry
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

In the second Cloud section, after crossing a gap using a large box, head up the stairs and into the tower to the north. Check the northwestern corner of this tower to find the Chest. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead.

_A destiny-defying firearm imbued with the power of the planet._

**Ability:** Turbulent Spirit — Significantly increase your ATB charge rate for a limited time. Can only be used once per battle.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Fill 2 ATB charges while active.

locations.title: Brísingamen
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Red XIII

In the second Aerith / Yuffie section, repair the area using the altar, then head into the western tower. It will be in the southwestern corner of it.

_An intricate collar crafted using a technology that surpasses modern scientific standards._

**Ability:** Reaper Touch — Deliver a deadly strike. Potency is inversely proportional to current HP.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate when HP is critically low.

locations.title: Fuma Shuriken
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Yuffie

After going down the spiral stairs and killing the Ancient Dragon and Pantera Protector, head down the stairs into a short corridor. This chest will be in a raised section on the north side of the corridor.

_A legendary throwing star said to soar like the wind, and strike down evil without making a sound._

**Ability:** Purification — ATB spent on other commands increases the amount of HP and MP absorbed. Can use while airborne. Shares gauge with Banishment. Max Level: III.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy with a Level III attack.

locations.title: Fafnir Rifle
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Barret

Awarded for completing the [The Pursuit of Perfection](#loc=329963) Odd Job.

_An ostentatious firearm crafted by a reclusive weaponsmoth._

**Ability:** Point Blank — Consume all ATB charges to deliver a close-range attack and send enemies flying.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Finish off an enemy.

locations.title: Dragon Claws
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Tifa

Awarded for the beating the 42,000 points in [Desert Rush's](#loc=323994) Standard difficulty.

_Gorgeous gloves with a dragonscale design._

**Ability:** Starshower — Unleash a flurry of powerful strikes. Increases strength of next command executed.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Follow up with an offensive ability or spell after using the weapon ability.

locations.title: Crescent Sickle
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Yuffie

Get 3,600 points in [Glide de Chocobo No. 1](#loc=324008).

_A bewitching weapon whose blade is studded with smaller daggers._

**Ability:** Shooting Star — Let the Shuriken fly across the battlefield, mowing down all enemies it touches. Can use while airborne.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Strike two or more enemies.

locations.title: Gjallarhorn
locations.description:
**Party Member:** Cait Sith

Return 45 tufts of Chocograss to the Chocobo Sage's [Tack Shop](#loc=345902).

_A luxurious megaphone passed down from one Kitty King to the next._

**Ability:** Lady Luck — Call upon the goddess of fortune to temporarily increase allies' critical hit rate.

**Proficiency Bonus:** Activate on a three-person party.

locations.title: Cosmo Canyon's Soaring Birds
locations.description: This Intel can be revealed on the map after you start the [Bonds of Trust](#loc=331191) side quest.

locations.title: Birds of The Mountain
locations.description:
**Rewards:**
- 2x Golden Plumes
- 10 Junon Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP

locations.title: All-Rounders of the Grasslands
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit [Bill's Chocobo Ranch](#loc=325589)

**Rewards:**
- 2x Golden Plumes
- 10 Grasslands Data Points
- 5 Party EXP

locations.title: Feathered Waverunners
locations.description:
**Rewards:**
- 2x Golden Plumes
- 10 Nibel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP

locations.title: Death from Below
locations.description:
**Level:** 31

**Enemies:** Duneworm

**Combat Objectives:**
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat the enemy without getting swallowed.
- Defeat the enemy within the time limit.

The Duneworm's Swallow attack is always preceded with it diving underground. Dodge sideways to avoid this attack.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Unholy Union
locations.description:
**Level:** 31

**Enemies:** 2x Silver Chimera

**Combat Objectives:**
- Exploit an enemy's weakness.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

The Silver Chimera's elemental weakness is to Fire-based attacks.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Seahorsing Around
locations.description:
**Level:** 26

**Enemies:** 4x Heliopora Terpsicolts

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

Pressure one of these enemies by either hitting it with an Ice-based attack, or dodging its Leech heavy attack.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Hit the Squids
locations.description:
**Level:** 25

**Enemies:** 3x Shankhalopods

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

To pressure a Shankalopod, hit it with a Fire-based attack.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Top of the Pecking Order
locations.description:
**Level:** 30

**Enemies:** 3x Saberhawks

**Combat Objectives:**
- Stagger an enemy.
- Don't get stunned.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

The Saberhawk's stunning move is its Zap Talon heavy attack.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Fish out of Water
locations.description:
**Level:** 30

**Enemies:** 3x Bladefins

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

To pressure a Bladefin, inflict enough damage after it has emerged from the ground.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Corel Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Forgotten Toys
locations.description:
Access by using Gliding Ranges [No. 6](#loc=323846), [No. 7](#loc=323849), [No. 13](#loc=323843), [No. 14](#loc=323848) and [No. 16](#loc=323845).

**Level:** 39

**Enemies:** Elder Golem

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

Elder Golems will automatically become Pressured after taking enough damage and/or throwing enough attacks.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Cosmo Canyon Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Too Hot to Handle
locations.description:
**Level:** 38

**Enemies:** 3x Pyrowire

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Cosmo Canyon Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Guardian of Gold
locations.description:
Access by using Gliding Ranges [No. 6](#loc=323846), [No. 7](#loc=323849) and [No. 8](#loc=323841).

**Level:** 39

**Enemies:** Shirdal

**Combat Objectives:**
- Exploit an enemy's weakness.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat the enemy within the time limit.

The Shirdal's weakness is to Lightning-based attacks.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Cosmo Canyon Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: The Shapeless Assassin
locations.description:
**Level:** 38

**Enemies:** 4x Bashfulisk

**Combat Objectives:**
- Pressure an enemy.
- Stagger an enemy.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

Bashfulisks can be Pressured by hitting them with an Ice-based attack.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Cosmo Canyon Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Fury Takes Flight
locations.description:
**Level:** 37

**Enemies:** 3x Drohdroh

**Combat Objectives:**
- Stagger an enemy.
- Unleash a Limit attack.
- Defeat all enemies within the time limit.

To increase the Limit Gauge while fighting a Drohdroh, intentionally get hit by its Fury Bomber and Enough Is Enough! attacks, which give you the Fury status effect.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Cosmo Canyon Region Data Points
- 5 Party EXP (Defeat All Enemies)
- 5 Party EXP (All Objectives)

locations.title: Wizards of the Waste
locations.description:
**Level:** 38

locations.title: Chapter 8: All That Glitters
locations.description:
**Level:** 27-29

_Following in the robed individuals' footsteps, the party leaves the down-at-heel settlement of North Corel for the glittering opulence of the Gold Saucer—the theme park that never sleeps. Rising high above the wastelands, it has truly earned its sobriquet as the "gilded paradise"._

locations.title: Chapter 2: A New Journey Begins
locations.description:
**Level:** 15-19

_After a long night, Cloud and company awake the next morning to the sleepy, bucolic town of Kalm. Aware that a long journey lies ahead of them, they decide to take advantage of this quiet moment to prepare for what awaits._

media.title: Chapter 2 - A New Journey Begins Banner

locations.title: Chapter 3: Deeper into Darkness
locations.description:
**Level:** 19-20

_The team proceeds into the Mythril Mine to pursue Sephiroth. Once famous for the eponymous ore it produced, the site is now nothing more than a fiend-filled monument to a world that was destroyed by Shinra's greed._

locations.title: Chapter 4: Dawn of a New Era
locations.description:
**Level:** 21-23

_The party exits the Mythril Mine to discover the Junon region, a windswept coastal territory where the shadow of Shinra looms large. Once a symbol of republic freedom, this land now stands as a testament to Shinra's prosperity—and the carnage wrought to achieve it._

media.title: Chapter 4 - Dawn of a New Era Banner

locations.title: Chapter 5: Blood in the Water
locations.description:
**Level:** 23

_Cloud and company continue their pursuit of the robed individuals aboard a cruise ship. Their destination: Costa del Sol, a seaside resort where summer never ends and the party never stops. Though arrival in paradise is not until the next morning, the onboard festivities have already begun._

media.title: Chapter 5 - Blood in the Water Banner

locations.title: Chapter 6: Fool's Paradise
locations.description:
**Level:** 24

_After an unexpectedly eventful voyage, the cruise ship drops anchor at the resort paradise of Costa del Sol. Seeking respite among the sun and sand, the party makes way for the city center._

locations.title: Chapter 7: Those Left Behind
locations.description:
**Level:** 26-27

_As they leave Costa del Sol, the party bids farewell to the sun and fun in exchange for a new member: Yuffie. With this energetic ninja in tow, they follow the black robes in the direction of Mt. Corel—a once-thriving coal mine, and a location that evokes more than a few emotions in Barret._

locations.title: Chapter 9: The Planet Stirs
locations.description:
**Level:** 31-35

_Following a painful goodbye, the party resumes their journey—though to where, none of them can say. For the moment, they push southward, away from Corel._

locations.title: Chapter 10: Watcher of the Vale
locations.description:
**Level:** 36-39

_As the scale of the conflict continues to swell, the party cannot help but feel they are embroiled in a battle for the future of the planet. Thus, where better to see guidance than Cosmo Canyon, the home of planetology?_

media.title: Chapter 10 - Watcher of the Vale Banner

locations.title: Chapter 11: The Long Shadow of Shinra
locations.description:
**Level:** 39-42

_The Party makes its way to Nibelheim on Cait Sith's word that there will be a Shinra terminal via which they can ascertain the temple's location. Though Cloud and Tifa agree to the plan, they hold out little hope as they approach the village Sephiroth burned to the ground five years ago._

media.title: Chapter 11 - The Long Shadow of Shinra Banner

locations.title: Chapter 12: A Golden Key
locations.description:
**Level:** 42-44

_The party discovers that in order to access the Temple of the Ancients—in which rests the Black Materia—they will need the keystone, a relic last seen at the Gold Saucer. Meanwhile, war is brewing in the world. Wutai has publicly declared their intent to topple Shinra and the city of Midgar, yet the company is unfazed. Their focus remains locked on one thing only—reaching the temple and discovering the promised land._

locations.title: Chapter 13: Where Angels Fear to Tread
locations.description:
**Level:** 45-49

_Rufus orders all hands on deck in his effort to reach that which he deems "the promised land": the fabled Temple of the Ancients. In pursuit of the Black Materia allegedly contained therein, Cloud and company follow Shinra's lead. Though the two parties' motives may differ, their destination is the same, with both groups set to coalesce in the land up north._

media.title: Chapter 13 - Where Angels Fear to Tread Banner

locations.title: Chapter 14: End of the World
locations.description:
**Level:** 49

_Having entrusted Cloud with her White Materia, Aerith ventures alone into the depths of the Sleeping Forest, determined to put a stop to Sephiroth's plans._

media.title: Chapter 14 - End of the World Banner

locations.title: Chapter 1: Fall of a Hero
locations.description: _After a harrowing battle in Midgar with an otherworldly twist, the group continues their pursuit of Sephiroth. They make a stop in the village of Kalm, where Cloud reveals his connection to their uncanny enemy and what happened on that fateful day in Nibelheim five years ago._

media.title: Chapter 1 - Fall of a Hero Banner

locations.title: When Words Won't Do
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](#loc=323909)

**Level:** 21

_I'm looking to hire a bodyguard. My boy Salmon needs to make a delivery, and I don't want a fiend even looking at him the wrong way. Come and see me if you're interested._

**Rewards:**
- Entry intro [The Crow's Nest](#loc=323895)
- 10 Party EXP
- 500 EXP
- Barret affinity
- Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. I
- 3x Mythril Ore
- 2x Rubies

locations.title: Stuck In A Rut
locations.description:
**Level:** 20

_Been making deliveries since way back when, but now that one of my carriage's wheels broke, I've had to suspend service. If I could get my hands on a replacement, I suppose I could fix the damn thing, but honestly, maybe this is all for the best..._

**Rewards:**
- Queensguard Bangle
- 10 Party EXP
- 500 EXP
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: Of Robed Men and Ransoms
locations.description:
**Level:** 28

One of the robed fellows I've been looking after has been abducted. Whatever damn fool that did it left behind a note demanding money, but I'm in no position to pay. There's no telling what'll happen to the man if I don't, though, so if someone out there's willing to track down and rescue the poor bastard, you'd be doing us a favor.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 600 EXP
- Tale of the Red Warrior Vol. II
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: A Rare Card Lost
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Wrangle](#loc=325590) and [race](#loc=325858) Piko the Chocobo

_Got beat bad at Queen's Blood, but the real stinger was when I had to give up the rare card I'd staked on the match. I'm looking for a pro to win it back on my behalf. If you think you've got what it takes, drop by the bar._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 400 EXP
- Card #107: Chocobo & Moogle
- Tifa affinity
- Thorin's Card Shop

locations.title: Lifeline in Peril
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Wrangle](#loc=325590) and [race](#loc=325858) Piko the Chocobo

**Level:** 18

_The mako pipeline upon which Kalm and her people rely has sprung a leak, and we are in desperate need of a technician - or failing that, someone with a modicum of skill - to perform emergency repairs. The welfare of our residents hangs in the balance!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 300 EXP
- 3,000 gil
- Barret affinity

locations.title: Livestock's Bane
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Wrangle](#loc=325590) and [race](#loc=325858) Piko the Chocobo

**Level:** 8

_A clever fiend of some sort's been preying on my livestock of late, and if I can't put a stop to it, my farm's doomed. Seems clear a run-of-the-mill hunter won't cut it, so I'm in the market for a merc with solid tracking skills._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 400 EXP
- 1x Owl Bracer
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: Flowers from the Hill
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Wrangle](#loc=325590) and [race](#loc=325858) Piko the Chocobo

**Level:** 17

_My sister's lookin' for help. Not sure what the trouble is. Didn't wanna confide in me for whatever reason. Honestly, she hasn't been herself since Mom left. They did dang near everything together._

Chloe of Bill's Ranch wants to make a gift for her older brother in order to lift his spirits.

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 300 EXP
- Telluric Scriptures Vol. I
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: Where the Wind Blows
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [Livestock's Bane](#loc=325860)

**Level:** 22

_A good friend of mine's in need of assistance with a repair job, but with my health trouble, I fear I'd do more harm than good. If you're willing to lend her a hand in my stead, come and see me at the inn. And quickly, please._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 300 EXP
- Whistlewind Scarf
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: The Saga of Seaside Inn
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin [Chapter 7: Those Left Behind](#loc=326927)

**Level:** 31

This sidequest cannot be fully completed until you reach Chapter 9.

_Johnny's Seaside Inn is currently undergoing a complete renovation to better cater to you, out beloved customers! And, uh...we could use a little help. Help that isn't me. And my "me" I mean "we". And by "we" I mean...uh, it'll be easier to explain when you meet the gang. And by "you" I mean my one true bro, Cloud! Don't leave me hanging!"_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,000 EXP
- Card #134: J-Squad
- Yuffie affinity
- Treasure Trove Collector's Items displays

locations.title: Calling All Frogs
locations.description:

**Rewards:**

- 500 EXP
- Tifa affinity

locations.title: The Hardest Sell
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](#loc=323909)

**Level:** 23

_So there's this lighthouse that's my favourite hangout spot, but now some rando calling themselves the "Merc of Junon" has rolled up and claimed it as their new HQ. I don't know what their deal is, but they're sure not doing jack about the fiends in the area, so I'd love it if someone could tell 'em to, you know, beat it or whatever_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 500 EXP
- Merc Chocobo Gear (Cap, Overalls & Legwraps)
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: Dreaming of Blue Skies
locations.description:
**Prerequisites:**
- Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](#loc=323909)

**Level:** 23

_Our beloved condor has not graced the skies above Junon in quite some time. We worry for her welfare and wish to hire someone to prepare a culinary feast that she will find too tempting to resist. Those willing to provide assistance are invited to join us on Condor Hill._

**Rewards:**
- ??

locations.title: Rendezvous in Costa del Sol
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Reach Chapter 7

**Level:** 25

_Hey lovebirds, we need your help in creating our next line of classic swimwear! All you have to do is go on a very special date we've planned that's sure to bring you and your partner closer together than ever. So come and see us on the beach if you're in the mood for romance!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 700 EXP
- The Art of Swordplay Vol. II
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: Bodybuilders in a Bind
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [Rendezvous in Costa del Sol](#loc=327202) side quest

**Level:** 26

_It's time to muscle maximize—or at least it was, until a bunch of fiends showed up and started scaring our members. Even the most passionate builder would struggle to get into a rhythm with those things hanging around, so we need an able-bodied merc to come save the day—and our gains._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 500 EXP
- Tifa affinity
- 3x Celeris (beat Amina in the crunch-off)

locations.title: Missing: Mr. Birdie
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin [Chapter 9](#loc=326929)

**Level:** 30

_Mr. Birdie didn't come home for dinner, and no one knows where he is! We're worried something bad might've happened to him. Can anyone help us find him? Please?_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 900 EXP
- Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia
- Barret affinity

locations.title: The Pursuit of Perfection
locations.description:
**Level:** 31

_I've been striving to create the greatest weapon that ever was, but despite my best efforts, I've yet to make any meaningful progress. There's an essential element I'm missing, the seed of inspiration—but I *know* it's out there! I just need something or someone to help me grasp it!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,100 EXP
- Fafnir Rifle (Barret)
- Barret affinity

locations.title: O Chicken, Where Art Thou
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit the Gongaga Reactor

**Level:** 33

_You wouldn't believe the state of my chicken coop! Poked full of fresh holes because of that black stuff from the reactor. Some were big enough for my little dears to wriggle through and run off, and now I'm scrambling to track them down before some beastie gets to them first. Oh, if only a king soul would come lend me a hand..._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,200 EXP
- Lucky Amulet
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: Teach Me, Great Warrior
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit the Gongaga Reactor

**Level:** 34

_I'm looking for someone to teach me the ways of the warrior—to help me reach my full potential! No matter the suffering, no matter the sacrifice, I'm willing to do whatever it takes!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,200 EXP
- Secrets of the Ninja Vol. IV
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: The Spice of Life
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:**
- Visit the Gongaga Reactor
- Complete the [Teach Me, Great Warrior](#loc=330265) odd job

**Level:** 35

_Gongaga mushroom soup may seem like a simple dish to most people, but making it is harder than you'd expect. My attempts aren't coming together, and the flavor is always just a little bit off. I don't know if something's missing, or if I added one too many ingredients, or what..._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,300 EXP
- Chakra Materia Earrings
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: Bonds of Trust
locations.description:
_Wanna put your chocobo-riding skills to the test? Then why not take on a ring course? I had it built custom for my daughter, but since she's not putting it to use these days, I figure anyone with a mind up to their game out to take advantage. Don't be a stranger!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,500 EXP
- Tale of the Red Warrior Vol. VI
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: Lament of the Damned
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Dock at Costa del Sol during Chapter 12

**Level:** 44

_Tell me you've heard it too. The woman in the manor, weeping or wailing or...I don't know. I don't_ want _to know. really—can't bring bring myself to even go into the manor these days. But someone needs to get to the bottom of this...or I'll never be able to sleep again._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 3,300 EXP
- The Art of Swordplay Vol. VI
- Barret affinity
- Shinra Manor Combat Simulator

locations.title: My White-Haired Angel
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Explore and leave [Shinra Manor](#loc=345689).

**Level:** 41

_The darling little cat I feed from time to time hasn't come around for a while, and it's making me sick with worry. I know they can be independent souls, but she's never been one to turn down a good meal..._

**Rewards:**
- Aerith's Theme sheet music
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,200 EXP
- Way of the First Vol. VI
- Tifa affinity

locations.title: Esoteric Secrets of the Elders
locations.description:
_Chocobos are lovely creatures, but they can be a handful if you don't know the proper techniques. I offer personal training tailored to your specific needs. Sign up now for a special course at my retreat which includes three meals, afternoon naps, and a luxurious pool open all hours of the day._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,000 EXP
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: Absence of a Sign
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [Cave of the Gi](#loc=323857)

**Level:** 38

_Portents of calamitous ruin have been sighted in the vale of late—dreadful fiends whose very presence heralds doom. But all is not yet lost, for in times past we have observed celestial phenomena indicative of the great mother's triumph over such forces. We request assistance with spotting and photographing said phenomena; seek out the mentor Caesar for more information._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,700 EXP
- Tarot Cards
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: From Whence Life Flows
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [Cave of the Gi](#loc=323857)

**Level:** 38

_It's been entirely too long since I've done some old-fasioned fieldwork, and I'd like to correct that. Unfortunately, I seem to have misplaced my tools. Drop by and lend a hand, won't you?_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,700 EXP
- Fortunes Untold Vol. IV
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: Promises to Keep
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [From Whence Life Flows](#loc=348554) Odd Job

**Level:** 42

_Hey Nanaki, the survey team came back early—said there's Gi down in the canyon basin. Come see me as soon as you read this!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 1,900 EXP
- Mythical Amulet
- Red XIII affinity

locations.title: Trouble in Paradise
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

**Level:** 44

_It is my solemn charge to keep our slice of beachside paradise free from all manner of unpleasantness. To that end, I employed a freelancer to resolve a simple matter...which they have failed to do in a timely fashion. And so I must once more seek outside assistance—this time to deal with _two_ problems. Rest assured you will be well compensated._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,600 EXP
- Secrets of the Ninja Vol. VI
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: Gold Cup or Bust
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

_Hey Cloud, if you're reading this and I have told you in person yet—we got permission to race in the Gold Cup! It's a major racing event and a real honor, believe me. When you're read to challenge the best of the best, I'll be waiting for you in Chocobo Square!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,900 EXP
- Tifa affinity

locations.title: Hustle and Grind
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

**Level:** 43

_Beck's Business wants YOU! We are currently recruiting respectable businessmen and women eager to engage in respectable business activities. Salary is commiserate on performance; we offer commissary compensation. Work hard and you'll make bank! Drop by our recruitment center and submit your application today!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,400 EXP
- Sharpshooter's Companion Vol VI
- Barret affinity

locations.title: Tides of War and Worry
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

_Grown-ups have been talking about war with Wutai a lot lately, and it's really getting my friends down. I wanna try and take their minds of it all—do something fun—but I'm not sure what. If anyone has ideas, I'm all ears._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,400 EXP
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: Escape from Endless Writer's Block
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

_I came to Gongaga to find inspiration for my next children's book, but even in this verdant forest I feel the walls closing in all around me! I'm trapped in a mental prison—a maze of my own making—and need a muse to deliver me from the creative doldrums!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,600 EXP
- Crescent Moon Charm
- Barret affinity

locations.title: Victim of Circumstance
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin Chapter 12

**Level:** 45

_Was headed to the airstrip when I had a run-in with one hell of a fiend. Led it on a merry chase until my baby's engine gave up the ghost, and now I'm stranded here. I can fix her, but so long as that bastard's still around, I doubt I'll get far regardless. If anyone can come and bail me out, I'd be in your debt._

Begin by going to [Fiend Location 1](#loc=349184).

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,900 EXP
- Lv. 1 Magnify Materia
- Yuffie affinity

locations.title: Beneath Still Waters
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [Tides of War and Worry](#loc=348968)

**Level:** 45

_Be advised: a fearsome fiend is presently contained within Crater Cape. Civilians are strongly encouraged to avoid this area until the threat has been addressed. Active duty and retired military are requested to render assistance._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,400 EXP
- Telluric Scriptures Vol. VI
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: Sand and Circuses
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [Trouble in Paradise](#loc=348965) side quest

**Level:** 45

_Everyone's favorite dustbowl asshole is throwing a "party,", and there's a "prize" up for grabs that I need to win. So I joined the festivities—several times—but just couldn't hak it. "We'll meet again"—that's what she tried to tell me, but I guess it's you I hope I'll meet again first, merc. Come and find me, please._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,600 EXP
- Way of the Fist Vol. VI
- Tifa affinity

locations.title: Woodland Vigil
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [Escape from Endless Writer's Block](#loc=348972) side quest

**Level:** 44

_Attention GYC members--as you may have heard, we've received reports of especially dangerous fiends near the village. I've decided to personally look into this, so I'll be heading to the observation tower. Unit leaders are in charge while I'm away._

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 2,600 EXP
- Fortunes Untold Vol. VI
- Aerith affinity

locations.title: The Pirate King's Treasure
locations.description:

**Level:** 46

**Rewards:**

locations.description:

**Level:** 46

_Fellow disciples of diversions and delights, to you I issue a challenge! I, once a man of middling achievements, now lauded as a champion of champions, have set new high scores in the most beloved of the Gold Saucer's many attractions. Come, players, and pit your skills against mine, and strive to claim my title of Ultimate Party Animal!_

**Rewards:**
- 10 Party EXP
- 3,100 EXP
- Lv. 1 Gambler Materia
